claims.text: Treat reach growth as the trade-off: under suggestion mode the seed list guides optimization rather than constraining the audience to a similarity threshold, so you may gain broader reach but give up direct control over how closely the audience matches the seed — measure whether conversions and CPA hold or improve against that looser constraint. No vendor uplift figures are provided, so any improvement must be measured in your own campaign data.

relationships.name: Lookalike Audiences
relationships.difference: Meta's Lookalike Audiences give the advertiser a percentage-range control over how closely the new audience matches the source audience, with smaller percentages matching the source more closely and larger ones creating a bigger, broader audience; Google Demand Gen Lookalike segments are evolving to suggestion mode where the seed list acts as a signal for AI optimization rather than a similarity-threshold control.
relationships.context: Cross-platform comparison of lookalike-style prospecting features; different vendors and documentation.

evidence.locator: "When you create your lookalike audience, you can use a percentage range to choose how closely you want your new audience to match your source audience."
evidence.source_title: About Lookalike Audiences

relationships.name: Actalike audiences
relationships.difference: Pinterest's Actalike audiences let the advertiser select the country and a percentage range of people to target and exclude the source audience from the new audience; Google Demand Gen Lookalike segments in suggestion mode use the seed list as an AI signal for campaign goals instead of offering similarity-percentage targeting.
relationships.context: Cross-platform comparison of lookalike-style prospecting features; different vendors and documentation.
